phase: PX4-MuJoCo Phase 3A External Odometry Interface Preflight
scope: source audit, offline adapter/tests and interface design only; no SITL, fusion, arming or flight

interface.wire: MAVLink2 ODOMETRY over existing simulator TCP link, offline encoded only
interface.estimator_type: MAV_ESTIMATOR_TYPE_UNKNOWN (0): simulated ground truth; not claimed VIO
interface.time_usec: MuJoCo sample capture time; simulator receiver currently ignores it and sets PX4 receive time as timestamp_sample
interface.covariance: Full 6x6 transformed and packed upper triangle; pinned PX4 uses only linear position, attitude and velocity diagonals
interface.quality: Explicit synthetic source metadata; current EKF2_EV_QMIN=0 disables threshold

independent_review.minor_limitation: Covariance symmetry uses absolute 1e-10 tolerance; at tiny scale it can admit relative asymmetry. Pinned PX4 ignores off-diagonal entries; improve before real sensor covariance use.

risks: SimulatorMavlink stamps odometry with PX4 receipt time, so delayed source measurement timing cannot be faithfully represented yet
Current EV_CTRL=0; current GNSS aiding/height reference remain enabled
Current flight safety telemetry requires GNSS position, so GNSS-denied flight is blocked pending separately reviewed gate redesign
Covariance, quality, sensor calibration, transport latency and FAST-LIO2 reset semantics have no live validation
next_stage: Separately authorize a disarmed SITL ODOMETRY receipt/fusion and timestamp-path validation while GNSS remains available; do not fly or remove GNSS until evidence and safety-gate changes pass review
